source: Anthropic first-party API list prices in USD per million tokens, as documented on 2026-09-24: base input/output per model; cache writes 1.25x (5-minute) and 2x (1-hour) input; cache reads 0.1x input except where a model lists its own rate (Opus 5.5 $0.20, Fable 5.1 $0.25). Verify against https://www.anthropic.com/pricing before any paid run.
